question.text: A PMS client wants exposure to HIGH-YIELD corporate bonds (sub-investment grade). The PM's PRIMARY risk focus should be:

explanation.text: The Logic: High-yield bonds (junk) have default risk dwarfing other risks — credit analysis (4 Cs) and recovery-value estimation dominate the PM's day. The Trap: Interest rate and liquidity matter but are secondary; credit is the defining risk of high-yield. Cross-Exam Context: XV and IV cover credit deep-dive; XXI-B tests focus allocation. Manager's Pro-Tip: Sizing and diversification matter more than forecasting in high-yield — no PM is right on every bet, but concentrated wrong bets kill funds.
